objective: Upgrade the current fixed-candidate RefCOCO evidence into a reviewable external-alignment experiment suite without mixing fixed-candidate and open-box claims.

fixed_candidate_protocol.claim_boundary: OVHA is evaluated as a detector-agnostic operator-valued reranking layer, not as an end-to-end open-box detector.

strong_same_candidate_baselines.input: text tokens, frozen CLIP region features, normalized bbox geometry, candidate mask
strong_same_candidate_baselines.architecture: 2-4 layer lightweight transformer with bbox embeddings and per-region logits
strong_same_candidate_baselines.purpose: Controls for the possibility that the previous cross-attention reranker was too weak or geometry-blind.

strong_same_candidate_baselines.input: CLIP similarity, region feature, bbox geometry, expression length, pooled text feature
strong_same_candidate_baselines.purpose: Tests whether OVHA gains are only explained by adding bbox geometry.

strong_same_candidate_baselines.input: text tokens, region tokens, candidate mask
strong_same_candidate_baselines.architecture: parameter-matched transformer encoder with region classification head
strong_same_candidate_baselines.purpose: Provides a stronger same-candidate grounding-transformer-style reranker without claiming a TransVG reproduction.

strong_same_candidate_baselines.input: raw image, referring expression, fixed OVHA candidate boxes
strong_same_candidate_baselines.architecture: external detector boxes mapped to fixed candidates by IoU-weighted detector score
strong_same_candidate_baselines.purpose: Aligns GroundingDINO with the fixed-candidate evaluator while marking the feature source difference.

comparison_tracks.input: raw image plus expression, then exact OVHA fixed candidates
shared GroundingDINO top-K proposal boxes, proposal CLIP region features, referring expression

operator_subset_diagnostics.selection_rule: expression contains spatial terms such as left, right, top, bottom, above, below, near, next to, behind, in front of, between
operator_subset_diagnostics.expected_evidence: SRO gain is largest on spatial expressions.

operator_subset_diagnostics.selection_rule: expression contains color, size, or appearance words such as red, blue, small, large, striped, wearing, hat, shirt
operator_subset_diagnostics.expected_evidence: Report whether the admitted bank leaves a systematic attribute error profile that justifies AMO.

operator_subset_diagnostics.selection_rule: same-category candidates >= 2, high candidate overlap or close center distance, or close CLIP top-k scores
operator_subset_diagnostics.expected_evidence: TLEO gain is largest when dense local distractors exist.

operator_subset_diagnostics.selection_rule: token count above threshold or expression contains multiple noun phrases or relation words
operator_subset_diagnostics.expected_evidence: CATO gain is largest on long, relational, or hard-alignment expressions.

final_tables.scope: same fixed candidates and frozen CLIP features, plus explicitly marked GroundingDINO same-candidate scorer
operator responsibility subsets for SRO, TLEO, CATO, and attribute error profile
shared GroundingDINO proposal pool with oracle upper bound reported first
reported or separately reproduced open-box grounding references; no fixed-candidate win/loss claims
CMU-MOSEI, RefCOCO fixed-candidate, and GroundingDINO proposal admitted banks
